points.quote: Incomappleux River FSR Road Deactivation Prescription Map Section 2

WP 2-6 = BRIDGE/RB/RNSC LEXINGTON CREEK. Remove bridge and restore natural stream channel. Bridge is NOT passable Wet crossing required on high side. 1.5 hrs of machine time expected to create crossing.

map_readings.label: Incomappleux River FSR Road Deactivation Prescription Map Section 2
map_readings.shows: Map title. Section table: Section 2 7266m; Section 2 (to be surveyed) 6412m. The prescribed stretch is drawn as an orange line (legend: Deactivation Prescription). No km labels are printed.

map_readings.label: WP 2-1 = POC Start of deactivation survey for Section 2
map_readings.shows: Point of Commencement (green triangle) where the orange deactivation line meets the green line.

map_readings.label: To Be Surveyed in 2026
map_readings.shows: Legend entry for the green line that continues the road beyond WP 2-1; no prescription is marked on that stretch.

map_readings.label: WP 2-6 = BRIDGE/RB/RNSC LEXINGTON CREEK. Remove bridge and restore natural stream channel. Bridge is NOT passable Wet crossing required on high side. 1.5 hrs of machine time expected to create crossing.
map_readings.shows: Bridge Removal symbol (red X) on the orange deactivation line at Lexington Creek.

map_readings.label: WP 2-3 = PFH - start Start of full pull back required along a 40m long section of rd.
map_readings.shows: GPS point on the orange line marking the start of a full pull back section (ends at WP 2-4 = PFH - end).

map_readings.label: KEY MAP
map_readings.shows: Inset satellite map at 1:500,000 showing the road in orange and green north of the labels Arrow Lake, Trout Lake, Hwy 31 and Hwy 23 S; no closures marked.
